text:
Corvane Motors has put a number on how far its new E3 delivery van will travel on a single charge: 290 kilometres.

The figure appears in the Corvane E3 Technical Specification Sheet, Rev. 2, which the company released at the Northmere Commercial Vehicle Expo and published on 14 March 2025. I read the sheet at the Corvane stand, and it lists the 290 km range alongside a 78 kWh usable battery.

Halvard Okonkwo-Reyes, chief powertrain engineer at Corvane Motors, confirmed the pairing when I spoke to him. He told me the 78 kWh of usable capacity is what supports the stated range.

The sheet gives no other range figures, and I have not seen the van driven on a route. For now, 290 kilometres is the number Corvane has put in writing.
